title: Cracked Lava Sorceress
description: A close-up portrait of a pale woman with glowing orange cracks across her face and body, resembling molten lava. She wears an ornate magenta and gold gown with black armor plates, her hair styled in an elaborate updo with golden filigree and green foliage, set against a decaying stone archway with screaming faces emerging from the walls.
prompt: A regal pale-skinned woman with intricate glowing orange lava cracks across her face, neck, and chest, wearing a luxurious magenta velvet gown with elaborate golden filigree and black armored pauldrons, her hair in an ornate updo intertwined with golden ornaments and green leaves, standing before a crumbling mossy stone archway with screaming faces emerging from the cracked walls, dark fantasy atmosphere with molten drips and glowing embers
